video_title: Will Spurs BOUNCE Back in Game 5?!?

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Spurs' mental struggles in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: they are making some mental mistakes their inexperience is just glaring
quotes.quote: Mentally, that's going to take a toll on them. I think we're going to see a lot about them and how much they can move forward after blowing the 29-point lead in the last game. It's going to be tough. Is it possible? Sure, I think they have enough talent. I think they are the more talented team, but they are making some mental mistakes their inexperience is just glaring.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the Knicks' potential to close out the series
quotes.excerpt: the first team that's going to play four quarters is going to put themselves in a different direction
quotes.quote: The series is over. We're still yet to see the New York Knicks put together four complete quarters. They've shown if they're close, if they stay in this ball game, they got enough talent and they got enough confidence to get over the hump and beat this team. They've shown that already. Now, the first team that's going to play four quarters is going to put themselves in a different direction. Obviously, the Knicks are one game away from winning the championship.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the Spurs' lack of playoff experience
quotes.excerpt: I'd say they chunked this season up to just inexperience, this is a learning curve for everybody
quotes.quote: I don't think the Spurs have a chance as of now. I'd say they chunked this season up to just inexperience, this is a learning curve for everybody involved when it comes to this Spurs group. Do they have the talent? Obviously they do. They've shown that they can create a lead in each game they played in, it's just about figuring out how to close out these games. That's the next step for this young Spurs team.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Spurs' home court advantage
quotes.excerpt: it's a three-game series and we have home court
quotes.quote: I think they just have to look at it like a three-game series. My heart is going to be, you have to block out the first four games, what's happened, those comebacks. That's going to be very hard to forget what just happened in the last game. But at the end of the day, it's a three-game series and we have home court. That's what I'm telling the guys, we already beat them on their floor.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams and Chandler Parsons on baiting Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: I got a guy one flagrant away from being out of this series, that gives me a way better shot

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: If I'm the New York Knicks, I got a guy one flagrant away from being out of this series, that gives me a way better shot to win this championship. Now I'm going to fight a little bit. Now I got good credit. Now I want to fight, now I want to get him going. If I'm the New York Knicks, I'm coming out with a physical game plan, I'm going to make Wembanyama work for everything that he wants on the offensive end.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: I could argue that was a flop, honestly.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the ethics of baiting flagrant fouls
quotes.excerpt: we talk about unethical basketball at times as far as foul baiting. So flagrant baiting isn't the same type deal?
quotes.quote: We talk about unethical basketball at times as far as foul baiting. So flagrant baiting isn't the same type deal? I'm glad Lou spoke, we now see the thought process that these small guards in the league go through. The true colors are showing. I'm glad you spoke the way you spoke, Lou. Now people are understanding what us big men go through when it comes to dealing with these small guards.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the physical nature of big men
quotes.excerpt: I want a guy like LaMarcus Aldridge more than through elbows, the Dikembe, Shaq elbows
quotes.quote: I don't want a soft big man. I want a guy like LaMarcus Aldridge more than through elbows, the Dikembe, Shaq elbows. What are we talking about? And you know what? And when you talk about all them guys you just mentioned, when they highlight reel come up, they throwing hands with somebody in the highlight reel. They got their hands up. But none of them are labeled dirty or anything with that. I'm okay with it, but call it how we call it. I'm sorry, we got a legend on the other end, my bad. Let's go.
